verdict.rationale: Release notes describe a specific batching capability where 'small same-shape tasks batch into one dispatch, cutting subagent cost sharply on micro-task plans,' with batch reviews verifying every file in the brief made it into the diff — this is a real bulk-operation mechanism for micro-tasks in a plan. However, this is narrow (limited to same-shape subagent task batching within SDD plans) rather than general-purpose bulk operations across arbitrary items, and comes only from first-party release notes with no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations beyond same-shape micro-tasks (e.g., bulk file edits, bulk API calls across many independent items), and community/hands-on validation of the batching feature's reliability.
